data.description: Dodge the wraiths coming at you. Features 4 game modes.
Sandbox-2D is a sandbox survival game where you can build, destroy and explore.

data.title: 3D Toy Renderer

data.description: Game heavily inspired by Tetris. Play solo, battle against friends in versus or work together in co-op mode!

data.title: Screen Simulation
data.description: 2D screen simulator and sprite renderer capable of drawing rectangles and sprites. It simulates each pixel of the screen.

data.title: Kahnaroc
data.description: Kahnaroc is a minimalist conlang designed as a lighter and simpler alternative to English with unique punctuation, constant pronunciation and its own writing.
CX is a graphics library based on SFML to make writing SFML easier and more comfortable. It handles event boilerplate, a lot of the math and element positioning for the user.
Astral Surge is a speedrunning game focused on collecting all coins in time while evading traps and enemies. Features a fully-fledged level editor and endless mode.

data.title: Pong
data.description: Three different Pong clones. Battle against a friend or go against a bot of varying difficulties.
